mod = 998244353

def compute_permutation_sum(P, N, M):
    def prod(A, B, k, l, m):
        C = [[0] * m for _ in range(k)]
        for i in range(k):
            for j in range(m):
                C[i][j] = sum(A[i][pl] * B[pl][j] for pl in range(l)) % mod
        return C

    def plus(A, B, k, l):
        C = [[0] * l for _ in range(k)]
        for i in range(k):
            for j in range(l):
                C[i][j] = (A[i][j] + B[i][j]) % mod
        return C

    if N == 2:
        return 1

    if N == 3:
        A = [[2, 1], [2, 1]]
        POWA = [A]
        for _ in range(60):
            POWA.append(prod(POWA[-1], POWA[-1], 2, 2, 2))
        n = M
        X = [[abs(P[1] - P[0]) + abs(P[2] - P[1]), 4 - (abs(P[1] - P[0]) + abs(P[2] - P[1]))]]
        while n:
            X = prod(X, POWA[n.bit_length() - 1], 1, 2, 2)
            n -= 1 << (n.bit_length() - 1)
        return X[0][0]

    ALL = N * (N - 1) // 2
    A = [
        [ALL - (N - 2) * 2, (N - 2) * 2, 0],
        [1, ALL - 1 - (N - 3), N - 3],
        [0, 4, ALL - 4]
    ]
    POWA = [A]
    for _ in range(60):
        POWA.append(prod(POWA[-1], POWA[-1], 3, 3, 3))
    X = [[1, 0, 0]]
    n = M
    while n:
        X = prod(X, POWA[n.bit_length() - 1], 1, 3, 3)
        n -= 1 << (n.bit_length() - 1)

    AS = sum(i * (i + 1) // 2 for i in range(N))
    PX = [0]
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        plus = (N - i) * (N - i + 1) // 2
        minus = (i - 1) * (i - 1 + 1) // 2
        PX.append(plus + minus)

    ANS = 0
    for i in range(N - 1):
        a, b = P[i], P[i + 1]
        ANS += abs(b - a) * X[0][0]
        k = PX[a] - abs(b - a) + PX[b] - abs(b - a)
        ANS += k * X[0][1] * pow((N - 2) * 2, mod - 2, mod) % mod
        ANS += (AS - abs(b - a) - k) * X[0][2] * pow(ALL - 1 - (N - 2) * 2, mod - 2, mod) % mod
        ANS %= mod

    return ANS % mod
